name: Nishita et al. Ray Casting Method
definition: A ray casting method based on Max's ideas, using shadow and illumination volumes for scenes composed of polygons and integration at lit segments. Extended to deal with spotlights with angular distributions apart from parallel light sources.
summary: The Nishita et al. Ray Casting Method renders participating media by integrating radiance only over ray segments illuminated by light sources, avoiding shadowed regions to improve efficiency.
